face.guidanceCallsNote: Measured from one real attendance check-in in the demo access log (2026-11-04): 2 liveness challenge requests (PHP only), then 26 single-frame /v1/guidance calls about 0.6 s apart (paced by the phone), then one 9-frame /v1/verify. A face registration is 66 guidance calls then enrollment.
face.guidanceIntervalNote: Each simulated student sends a call, waits for it, then sleeps the rest of the interval; a call slower than the interval is followed immediately by the next.
face.limitNote: The PHP sidecar timeout per call (BIOMETRIC_SIDECAR_TIMEOUT_SECONDS); a verify call slower than this counts as over the limit.
